text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, it's the Hakodate Kinen, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We must secure a victory! After all, 
Hakodate is famous for its stars, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, you see that building over there? 
The star-shaped fort, Goryokaku!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to get my hands on a wonderful 
star that rivals Goryokaku and pray to it. 
Blessings, oh blessings~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Over there is Jousei, and over here is 
Shiroboshi (a white victory star). Let's 
bring both whites together side by side! 
Ohh!
